fixture_name: M5 Junction 10 Improvements — UK Stage 1 (real scheme, OGL)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Refuge width/depth adequacy against crossing demand from an adjacent bus stop is a substantive Stage 1 geometric safety issue on wide A4019 arms, addressable before detailed design.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim that refuges must safely house a cyclist is anchored by the verbatim EV-UK-015 quote ('not wide enough to safely house a cyclist... clipped by vehicles'), with the bus-stop demand element carried as a declared assumption citing Table 4-1.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a GG 119 Stage 1 safety_concern with no normative basis asserted, keeping the safety observation distinct from any compliance question.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable—specify refuge depth/width sized for a pushchair user plus a cycle at each named A4019 crossing point—which is viable to implement during detailed design.
justifications.vru_coverage: Both affected vulnerable groups (pedestrians crossing to the bus stop and cyclists using refuges) are explicitly identified and their conflict mechanisms considered.

justifications.substance: Verifying that recorded large-vehicle swept paths (refuse vehicle, 7.5t box van) remain valid after signal stop-line repositioning is a substantive geometric-compatibility check appropriate to Stage 1.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal claim that swept-path analysis was performed for these vehicle types is backed by the verbatim EV-UK-002 quote referencing Figures 4-1 to 4-4, including the noted limited over-run; no invented content.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a compliance question seeking designer confirmation rather than an asserted GG 119 problem, keeping the question category distinct from a safety problem statement.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific, actionable and viable: re-run large-vehicle swept-path analysis over the as-adjusted stop-line positions before Stage 2; not a null recommendation.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are acknowledged with recorded refuges and desire lines, but VRU-specific exposure is explicitly declared out of scope for this swept-path question, matching the acknowledge-but-not-applicable case.
